summary: Online code coverage reports for devel help find untested code, while PR code needs local coverage reporting via ansible-test.
questions: How do I find parts of Ansible that need more tests?
Do coverage reports include my PR's code?

answer_card.title: Code coverage
answer_card.answer_md: Drill into the red areas of the online coverage reports (devel branch only) to find untested files. PR code isn't included, so collect coverage locally; most `ansible-test` commands support it.
